title: Optimization: Maximum Profit
body:
A company manufactures and sells $x$ items per week. The weekly cost function is $C(x) = 500 + 12x$ rands, and the demand function is $p = 60 - 0.02x$ rands per item (where $p$ is the price).

Find the number of items that should be produced weekly to maximise profit.

Recall: Profit = Revenue - Cost, and Revenue = price $\times$ quantity.
